intro: A postcard arrived fifty years late. No name. No address. Only a clue: find what this city never lost. Chief, the next page is yours.
coast1: The tide leaves a small bottle on the sand. Inside: half a postcard, and a sketch of a boat. Someone nearby might know the rest.
market1: A shopkeeper slides a faded postcard across the counter. Half the picture is missing. The lane offers two leads. Which one do you follow?
coastBoat: The boatman laughs. Every tide brings something back. He points toward a café where a traveller once left a sketch. Your next clue smells like coffee.
coastCastle: You trace the postcard in the sand. A child recognizes the drawing: the old storyteller used to sit beneath those trees. You follow the shady promenade.
marketSweet: The sweet seller folds your clue into a paper bag. A good story needs something sweet, he says. A cinnamon trail leads you to the next window.
marketMemory: The shopkeeper remembers a traveller who drew every doorway. Look for the window with the blue shutters. You follow a trail of little sketches.
coast2: The second half is close. A warm café window. A quiet place facing the sea. Two ways to find the person behind the postcard.
market2: At the end of the lane, two people remember the missing picture. One serves the city on a plate. The other has kept its stories for years.
coffee: You trade a story for a clue. The café owner unfolds the last piece. The postcard was never asking for a place. It was asking you to notice the people.
horizon: At the viewpoint, you hold the postcard against the horizon. The missing lines fit the sea. The picture was waiting for you to finish it.
food: You listen as the cook tells a family memory. The final piece comes wrapped in a recipe. A city keeps its stories in the people who feed it.
keeper: The keeper opens a little notebook. There is your missing sketch. A city keeps its stories in the people who remember it.
finale: The two halves meet. The lost thing was curiosity. You found it between the stops. Thanks, Chief. Keep the postcard. Another road is waiting.
